verdict.rationale: Supabase's realtime docs describe online pub/sub features (Broadcast, Presence, Postgres Changes) that require an active connection, not an offline-first client SDK that queues local writes and syncs automatically on reconnect. No evidence pack item documents an offline persistence layer, local write queue, or conflict-resolution/sync-on-reconnect mechanism analogous to offline-first databases; this is a fair question for a BaaS product (comparable to Firebase's offline persistence) so it is not out of category, but no capability is evidenced.
